newsitem.title: INDIA: India Sterlite rises 3.6 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India Sterlite rises 3.6 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Indian cable manufacturer, Sterlite Industries rose 9.0 rupees, or 3.6 percent to 254.50 rupees in afternoon trade on Friday at the Bombay Stock Exchange after improved results, dealers said.
The company on Friday said its net profit for the first half ending December 1996 rose 2.7 percent to 705.3 million rupees against a net profit of 686.8 million rupees in the year-ago period.
"The results are mostly in line with market expectations. We were not really expecting too much growth in the first half net due to poor orders," said a dealer at a brokerage firm.
"But, people are optimistic about the second half. The company's plan not to diversify from their main business is also good news," the dealer said.
Sterlite said it had decided to "hive off a project for manufacture of 60,000 tpa writing and printing paper to be implemented in a separate company".
